headline: Congress named a federal courthouse in Wheeling, West Virginia, after former judge Frederick P. Stamp, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the federal building and U.S. courthouse at 1125 Chapline Street in Wheeling, West Virginia. The building will now be called the Frederick P. Stamp, Jr. Federal Building and United States Courthouse. It does not change how the building is used or who works there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2021.
